name: StreamingQA
description: StreamingQA is a large-scale dataset for evaluating question answering models' ability to adapt to evolving knowledge over time. It contains human-written and generated questions linked to 14 years of time-stamped news articles, enabling evaluation of models' knowledge updates and handling of dynamic information.
reputation: A useful but relatively specialized benchmark for temporal knowledge updating in QA, with limited mainstream adoption compared with larger static QA datasets.
notes: Focuses on temporal adaptation of QA models to new knowledge without full retraining; includes quarterly evaluation.
